title: crypto_memneq for PKCS1v1.5 verify: correct constant-time comparison
description: The switch from memcmp to crypto_memneq in wolfssl_rsa_verify is not defensive paranoia — it is correct. PKCS#1 v1.5 verify compares a computed digest to an expected value; a timing side-channel here leaks information about the secret. A contributor unfamiliar with crypto may suggest 'memcmp is simpler and this runs in kernel context anyway.' It is not simpler — it is wrong. Keep crypto_memneq.
